maria_cs: Heads-up — Osprey Labs needle test for Dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need final signoff on quota limits, autoscale windows, and the loadscript. cc @ashley_se @troy_sre
ashley_se: thanks — quota currently set to 12k req/min for their reserved pool, burst allowed to 18k for 15m. Is that still OK?
troy_sre: 12k baseline + 18k burst sounds fine. We should shrink the autoscale cooldown to 45s for the test so we can observe scale events quickly. Also enabling detailed VM metrics for that window.
maria_cs: good call. @ben_runtime can you prep the loadscript to exercise short-latency and long-context paths? want to prime both KV cache and batching behavior.
ben_runtime: yes. plan: 10m ramp to 8k qps (50% short prompts, 50% 2k token contexts) -> 20m steady at 12k -> 10m spike to 18k -> back down. will attach script: 
```bash
# simple locust snippet (pseudo)
- scenario: short_gen 50%
- scenario: long_gen 50%
- ramp: 0->8k in 10m
- steady 12k for 20m
- spike 18k for 10m
```
maria_cs: perfect. add prefix variation sets from their prod prompts (they shared 8 prompt families).
elena_customer: thanks team — quick question: will we see any throttling on our app side? we have graceful retry logic but want to avoid user errors.
ashley_se: if we hit burst limit some requests will be queued or 429'd depending on route. we'll enable a fallback model route for the first 30m to keep app-level success rate high.
troy_sre: routing policy: primary -> osprey-dedicated-v1, fallback -> osprey-hosted-small-v2. Failover will be automatic with logs flagged under tag "osprey-needle-2026".
ops-bot: deploy-notice: Reserved pool scaling policy updated for osprey-dedicated-v1 (cooldown:45s). Scheduled window: 2026-08-19T16:00:00Z -> 2026-08-19T17:00:00Z.
ben_runtime: attaching loadscript and the PromQL we'll use for SLO checks: `sum(rate(requests_total{env=\"osprey\"}[1m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket{env=\"osprey\"}[5m])) by (le))`.
maria_cs: capture these checkpoints for post-test retro: 1) observed scale events vs expected, 2) KV cache hit rate, 3) percent of fallback hits, 4) cost delta. I'll run the customer-facing recap doc after the test.
elena_customer: appreciated. can you add a customer contact for on-call if we see user-impacting errors?
troy_sre: assign oncall: @troy_sre and backup @ashley_se. pager channel: #osprey-incident.
maria_cs: ok, final checklist: 
- quotas confirmed (ashley)
- autoscale cooldown = 45s (troy)
- loadscript + dashboards (ben)
- fallback route live (ashley)
- oncall roster + pager channel (troy)
all: respond with :thumbsup: once set and we'll lock the window.
ashley_se: :thumbsup:
troy_sre: :thumbsup:
